about: Parameters for the Simulate model of sketch 22. Every value says where it comes from and whether it is synthetic. Replace placeholders with published values and update 'status'.
model: Enhanced temperature-index melt: melt per hour = tf * T + srf * (1 - albedo) * G, when T > tt. Applied to daily means x 24 h.

albedo_ice.source: Diolaiuti et al., AINEVA Neve e Valanghe 74: mean albedo of the unmodified glacier surface, 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010 (bare ice from 16 Jul at 2,900 m)

albedo_snow.status: SYNTHETIC placeholder; thesis 2012 gives dirty snow 0.27-0.47 (Aug); fresh snow value still to source

albedo_fleece.source: AINEVA Neve e Valanghe 74: mean albedo on the cover, 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010

albedo_fleece_reused.source: PhD thesis UniMi (Jan 2013), Tab. 1-2: TenCate Toptex GLS 340 reused, 0.433-0.44 in Aug 2012

ablation_2010_unmodified_m_we.source: AINEVA nv74, 1 Oct 2009-27 Sep 2010 at 2,900 m

melt_2010_covered_vs_unmodified_cm_we.source: AINEVA nv74, 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010, hours with T>0
